title: GeoGR: Spatial-Semantic Token Compression and Group Routing for Efficient 3D VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.13035v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-view representations enable pretrained image and video vision-language models to understand 3D scenes, but their long visual token sequences make inference costly. Redundancy arises both from repeated observations of the same scene regions across views and from processing all visual tokens at every LLM layer, regardless of their relevance to the current computation. We propose GeoGR, a two-stage framework that jointly compresses scene representations and visual computation. At the projector level, GeoSemZip consolidates cross-view observations into 3D voxel tokens and combines semantic saliency with spatial coverage to construct a compact scene representation. Unselected voxel features are aggregated into contextual anchors to retain scene information that would otherwise be discarded. translated_title: GeoGR：面向高效3D视觉语言模型的空间-语义令牌压缩与分组路由
translated_abstract: 多视角表示使预训练的图像和视频视觉语言模型能够理解3D场景，但其冗长的视觉令牌序列导致推理成本高昂。冗余一方面来自不同视角对同一场景区域的重复观察，另一方面来自在LLM的每一层都处理所有视觉令牌，而不考虑其与当前计算的相关性。我们提出GeoGR，这是一个联合压缩场景表示与视觉计算的两阶段框架。在投影器层面，GeoSemZip将跨视角观察整合为3D体素令牌，并结合语义显著性与空间覆盖来构建紧凑的场景表示。未被选中的体素特征被聚合为上下文锚点，以保留原本会被丢弃的场景信息。在LLM层面，我们识别出有效的视觉计算窗口，并观察到基于查询条件的令牌相关性保持局部稳定，但（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出GeoGR两阶段框架，通过将跨视角观察压缩为3D体素令牌（GeoSemZip）并在LLM层间进行令牌分组路由，联合压缩场景表示与视觉计算，从而实现高效的3D视觉语言模型推理。
en_tdlr: GeoGR is a two-stage framework that jointly compresses scene representations and visual computation for 3D VLMs by consolidating cross-view observations into 3D voxel tokens (GeoSemZip) and routing token groups across LLM layers, enabling efficient inference.
